articles.title_en: Bargaining Foundations for the Outside Option Principle
articles.title_cn: 外部期权原则的讨价还价基础
articles.abstract_en: We study a bargaining game in which a seller can trade with one of two buyers, who have values h and l (h>l). The outside option principle (OOP) predicts that, as players become patient, the seller trades with the high-value buyer with probability converging to 1 at a price converging to max(h/2,l). While this prediction is supported by the Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE), a wide range of trading outcomes may emerge in subgame perfect equilibria (SPEs): in the patient limit, the seller can obtain any price in the interval [h/2,h] (and no other); moreover, allocative inefficiency and costly delay are possible. We propose equilibrium refinements less restrictive than Markov behavior that guarantee trading outcomes consistent with the OOP. One refinement requires that a buyer’s relative probability of trade does not increase dramatically following a failed negotiation with that buyer. Another refinement posits that the seller does not approach a buyer hoping that negotiations fail. SPEs satisfying both refinements conform with the OOP (but need not be MPEs). Our benchmark model features strategic matching by the seller. We provide a parallel analysis for the random matching protocol. Under random matching, prices in SPEs may also rise above and fall below l, but have a narrower range. A refinement particular to this protocol that restores the OOP requires that a random mismatch should not impact the seller excessively.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一种讨价还价游戏，其中卖方可以与 一 个买方进行交易，这些买方的值为 h 和 l (h>l)。外部期权原理 (OOP) 预测，随着玩家变得耐心，卖方与高价值买方进行交易的概率收敛于 1，价格收敛于 max(h/2,l)。虽然这一预测得到了马尔可夫完美均衡 (MPE) 的支持，但在子博弈完美均衡 (SPE) 中可能会出现多种交易结果：在耐心极限下，卖方可以获得 [h/2,h] 区间内的任何价格（除此之外没有其他价格）；此外，分配效率低下和代价高昂的延误也是可能的。我们提出比马尔可夫行为限制更少的均衡改进，保证交易结果与 OOP 一致。 一细化要求买家的相对交易概率不会在与买家谈判失败后急剧增加。另一项改进假设卖方不会希望谈判失败而与买方联系。满足这两个细化的 SPE 符合 OOP（但不必是 MPE）。我们的基准模型以卖方的战略匹配为特色。我们为随机匹配协议提供并行分析。在随机匹配下，SPE 的价格也可能上涨或下跌至 l 以下，但幅度较小。该协议特有的一项改进是恢复 OOP，要求随机不匹配不应过度影响卖方。

articles.title_en: Search Direction: Position Externalities and Position Auction Bias
articles.title_cn: 搜索方向：头寸外部性和头寸拍卖偏差
articles.abstract_en: We formulate a tractable model of pricing under directed search with heterogeneous firm demands. Demand characteristics drive bids in a position auction and enable us to bridge insights from the ordered search literature to those in the position auction literature. Equilibrium pricing implies that the marginal consumer’s surplus decreases down the search order, so consumers optimally follow the firms’ position ordering. A firm suffers from “business stealing” by firms that precede it and “search appeal” from subsequent firms. We find rankings that achieve the maximal joint profit or consumer surplus by constructing firm-specific scores. A generalized second price auction for positions endogenizes equilibrium orders and bids are driven by position externalities that impact incremental profit from switching positions. The joint profit maximization order is upheld when firm heterogeneity concerns mostly their mark-up potentials. But the consumer welfare order is robust when firms differ mostly over their potential market sizes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在具有异质企业需求的定向搜索下制定了一个易于处理的定价模型。需求特征驱动头寸拍卖中的出价，并使我们能够将有序搜索文献中的见解与头寸拍卖文献中的见解联系起来。均衡定价意味着边际消费者剩余沿着搜索顺序递减，因此消费者最优地遵循企业的头寸排序。一家公司遭受先行公司的“业务窃取”和后续公司的“搜索吸引力”的困扰。我们通过构建特定于公司的分数来找到实现最大联合利润或消费者剩余的排名。头寸的广义第二价格拍卖会内生均衡订单，而出价由头寸外部性驱动，影响头寸转换带来的增量利润。当公司异质性主要涉及其加价潜力时，联合利润最大化顺序就会得到维持。但当企业在潜在市场规模上存在重大分歧时，消费者福利秩序是稳健的。

articles.title_en: Demand Shocks as Technology Shocks
articles.title_cn: 需求冲击与技术冲击一样
articles.abstract_en: We provide a macroeconomic theory where demand for goods has a productive role. A search friction prevents perfect matching between producers and potential customers. Larger demand induces more search, which, in turn, increases GDP and measured total factor productivity (TFP). We embed the product-market friction in a standard neoclassical model and estimate it using Bayesian techniques. Business cycles are driven by preference shocks, true technology shocks, and investment-specific shocks. Preference shocks have qualitatively similar effects as true productivity shocks. These shocks account for a large share of the fluctuations in consumption, GDP, and measured TFP and can be identified using shopping time data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一种宏观经济理论，其中商品需求具有生产性作用。搜索摩擦阻碍了生产商和潜在客户之间的完美匹配。更大的需求会引发更多的搜索，进而增加 GDP 和衡量的全要素生产率 (TFP)。我们将产品市场摩擦嵌入标准新古典模型中，并使用贝叶斯技术对其进行估计。商业周期是由偏好冲击、真正的技术冲击和特定投资冲击驱动的。偏好冲击与真正的生产率冲击具有本质上相似的影响。这些冲击在消费、GDP 和测量的 TFP 波动中占很大比例，并且可以使用购物时间数据来识别。

articles.title_en: Public Listing Choice with Persistent Hidden Information
articles.title_cn: 具有持续隐藏信息的公开上市选择
articles.abstract_en: How much does firm intangibility amplify CEOs’ persistent private information and reduce firms’ public listing propensity? We develop a model of competing public and private investors financing firms heterogeneously exposed to persistent private cash flows. Equilibrium financing is driven by information rent differentials in CEO compensation. We validate and structurally estimate the model using firm listing and CEO compensation data. We find private (intangible) cash flows exhibit 63% higher persistence than their tangible counterparts. Further, if firm intangibility levels returned to those of 1980, mean listing propensities would increase 5 percentage points while mean CEO variable pay growth would decrease by 61%.
articles.abstract_cn: 公司的无形性在多大程度上放大了首席执行官持久的私人信息并降低了公司公开上市的倾向？我们开发了一个公共和私人投资者相互竞争的模型，为不同程度暴露于持续私人现金流的公司提供融资。均衡融资是由首席执行官薪酬中的信息租金差异驱动的。我们使用公司上市和首席执行官薪酬数据验证并结构性地估计该模型。我们发现私人（无形）现金流比有形现金流表现出63%更高的持久性。此外，如果公司无形水平恢复到1980的水平，平均上市倾向将增加5个百分点，而平均CEO可变薪酬增长将下降61%。

articles.title_en: Making Decisions Under Model Misspecification
articles.title_cn: 在模型错误指定下做出决策
articles.abstract_en: We use decision theory to confront uncertainty that is sufficiently broad to incorporate “models as approximations.” We presume the existence of a featured collection of what we call “structured models” that have explicit substantive motivations. The decision-maker confronts uncertainty through the lens of these models, but also views these models as simplifications, and hence, as misspecified. We extend the max–min analysis under model ambiguity to incorporate the uncertainty induced by acknowledging that the models used in decision making are simplified approximations. Formally, we provide an axiomatic rationale for a decision criterion that incorporates model misspecification concerns. We then extend our analysis beyond the max-min case allowing for a more general criterion that encompasses a Bayesian formulation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用决策理论来应对足够广泛的不确定性，以纳入“近似模型”。我们假设存在一个我们称之为“结构化模型”的特色集合，这些模型具有明确的实质性动机。决策者通过这些模型的视角面对不确定性，但也将这些模型视为简化，因此被错误指定。我们在模型模糊性下扩展了最大-最小分析，以纳入由于承认决策中使用的模型是简化的近似而引起的不确定性。形式上，我们为包含模型错误指定问题的决策标准提供了一个公理化的基本原理。然后，我们将分析扩展到最大-最小情况之外，从而允许包含贝叶斯公式的更通用的标准。

articles.title_en: Revisiting the Non-Parametric Analysis of Time-Inconsistent Preferences
articles.title_cn: 重新审视时间不一致偏好的非参数分析
articles.abstract_en: We revisit the recent revealed preference analysis of sophisticated quasi-hyperbolic consumers by Blow et al. [(2021), “Non-parametric Analysis of Time-Inconsistent Preferences”, The Review of Economic Studies, 88, 2687–2734] (BBC). We show that BBC’s revealed preference test is too lax. There are non-rationalizable data that would pass their test. A basic problem with their test is that it requires finding a certain endogenous elasticity, without regard to the rationalizing utility. Their approach motivates a more stringent test, also based on first-order conditions, that would connect the endogenous elasticity and utility: We show that this test is also too lax. Aside from testing, we also discuss the possibility of recovering model parameters. We show that, even when discount factors are exactly identified, the approach followed in BBC allows for incorrect parameter values to lie in their identified set.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视 Blow 等人最近揭示的对复杂的准双曲线消费者的偏好分析。 [(2021)，“时间不一致偏好的非参数分析”，经济研究评论，88，2687-2734] (BBC)。我们表明 BBC 的显示偏好测试过于宽松。有些不可合理化的数据可以通过他们的测试。他们的测试的一个基本问题是，它需要找到一定的内生弹性，而不考虑合理化效用。他们的方法激发了更严格的测试，同样基于第一阶条件，将内生弹性和效用联系起来：我们表明这个测试也太宽松了。除了测试之外，我们还讨论了恢复模型参数的可能性。我们表明，即使折扣因子被准确识别，BBC 中遵循的方法也会允许错误的参数值存在于其识别的集合中。

articles.title_en: Pseudo Lindahl Equilibrium as a Collective Choice Rule
articles.title_cn: 作为集体选择规则的伪林达尔均衡
articles.abstract_en: A collective choice problem specifies a finite set of alternatives from which a group of expected utility maximizers must choose. We associate a collective pseudo market with every collective choice problem and establish the existence and efficiency of pseudo Lindahl equilibrium (PLE) allocations. We also associate a cooperative bargaining problem with every collective choice problem and define a set-valued solution concept, the ω-weighted Nash bargaining set where ω is a vector of welfare weights. We provide axioms that characterize the ω-weighted Nash bargaining set. Our main result shows that ω-weighted Nash bargaining set payoffs are also the PLE payoffs of the corresponding collective pseudo market with the same utility functions and incomes ω. We define a pseudo core for collective pseudo markets and show that pseudo Lindahl equilibria are in the pseudo core. We characterize the set of PLE outcomes of discrete allocation problems and show that they contain the set of pseudo Walrasian equilibrium outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 集体选择问题指定一组有限的替代方案，一组预期效用最大化者必须从中进行选择。我们将集体伪市场与每个集体选择问题联系起来，并建立伪林达尔均衡（PLE）分配的存在性和效率。我们还将合作谈判问题与每个集体选择问题联系起来，并定义了一个集值解决方案概念，即 ω 加权纳什谈判集，其中 ω 是福利权重向量。我们提供了表征 ω 加权纳什讨价还价集的公理。我们的主要结果表明，ω 加权纳什讨价还价设定的收益也是具有相同效用函数和收入 ω 的相应集体伪市场的 PLE 收益。我们为集体伪市场定义了一个伪核心，并表明伪林达尔均衡位于伪核心中。我们描述了离散分配问题的 PLE 结果集，并表明它们包含伪瓦尔拉斯均衡结果集。

articles.title_en: Overconfidence and Prejudice
articles.title_cn: 过度自信和偏见
articles.abstract_en: We develop a model of multi-dimensional misspecified learning in which an overconfident agent learns about groups in society from observations of his and others’ successes. We show that the average person sees his group relative to other groups too positively, and this in-group bias exhibits systematic comparative-statics patterns. First, a person is most likely to have negative opinions about other groups he competes with. Second, while information about another group’s achievements does not lower a person’s prejudice, information about economic or social forces affecting the group can, and personal contact with group members has a beneficial effect that is larger than in classical settings. Third, the agent’s beliefs are subject to “bias substitution”, whereby forces that decrease his bias regarding one group tend to increase his biases regarding unrelated other groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种多维错误指定学习模型，在该模型中，过度自信的主体通过观察自己和他人的成功来了解社会中的群体。我们发现，相对于其他群体，普通人对其群体的看法过于积极，而这种群体内偏见表现出系统性的比较静态模式。 第一，一个人最有可能对与他竞争的其他群体产生负面看法。 第二，虽然有关另一个群体成就的信息不会降低一个人的偏见，但有关影响该群体的经济或社会力量的信息可以降低一个人的偏见，并且与群体成员的个人接触所产生的有益影响比传统环境中更大。 第三，主体的信念受到“偏见替代”的影响，即减少他对一群体的偏见的力量往往会增加他对不相关的其他群体的偏见。

articles.title_en: Surviving Childhood: Effects of Removing a Child From Home
articles.title_cn: 幸存的童年：将孩子带离家的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of the court-ordered removal of children from home on health, crime, and education. To isolate causal effects, I exploit quasi-random variation in judge assignment together with across-judge variation in the tendency to favour removal in an instrumental variable design. Using a novel data set (N=26,579) based on Swedish court documents that I transcribe and link with detailed register data, I find that court-ordered out-of-home placement has large adverse effects on the mortality of the marginal child. These effects are primarily driven by suicides that occur while the removed child is still placed in out-of-home care. Removal also causes an increase in hospitalizations for mental illness and non-narcotic crimes. There is little evidence of adverse health effects for birth parents. I explore potential explanations for the detrimental effects on child health. Adverse care conditions and peer exposure appear to be important channels.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了法院下令将儿童逐出家门对健康、犯罪和教育的影响。为了隔离因果效应，我利用了法官分配中的准随机变化以及工具变量设计中倾向于去除的跨法官变化。使用基于我转录的瑞典法院文件并与详细登记数据链接的新颖数据集（N=26,579），我发现法院下令的户外安置对边缘儿童的死亡率有很大的不利影响。这些影响主要是由于被带走的儿童仍处于家庭外护理期间发生的自杀所致。驱逐还导致因精神疾病和非麻醉犯罪住院的人数增加。几乎没有证据表明对亲生父母的健康有不利影响。我探讨了对儿童健康有害影响的潜在解释。不利的护理条件和同伴接触似乎是重要的渠道。

articles.title_en: Quantifying the Benefits of Labour Mobility in a Currency Union
articles.title_cn: 量化货币联盟中劳动力流动的好处
articles.abstract_en: Unemployment differentials are greater between countries in the euro area than between U.S. states. In both regions, net migration responds to unemployment differentials, though the response is smaller in the euro area compared to the U.S. We use a multi-country DSGE model with cross-border migration to quantify Mundell’s hypothesis that labour mobility could substitute for independent monetary policy in a currency union. While not as effective as independent monetary policy, increased labour mobility reduces business cycle fluctuations for most countries in the euro area. However, Mundell’s conjecture does not hold uniformly. For countries that primarily face demand shocks, labour mobility stabilizes inflation and unemployment and improves welfare. If supply shocks are dominant however, labour mobility increases the cost of being in a currency union by magnifying inflation volatility.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧元区国家之间的失业率差异比美国各州之间的失业率差异更大。在这两个地区，净移民都会对失业率差异做出反应，尽管与美国相比，欧元区的反应较小。我们使用具有跨境移民的多国 DSGE 模型来量化蒙代尔的假设，即劳动力流动性可以替代货币联盟中的独立货币政策。虽然不如独立货币政策那么有效，但劳动力流动性的增加可以减少欧元区大多数国家的商业周期波动。然而，蒙代尔的猜想并不完全成立。对于主要面临需求冲击的国家来说，劳动力流动可以稳定通货膨胀和失业并改善福利。然而，如果供应冲击占主导地位，劳动力流动性就会放大通胀波动性，从而增加加入货币联盟的成本。

articles.title_en: Endogenous Clustering and Analogy-Based Expectation Equilibrium
articles.title_cn: 内生聚类和基于类比的期望均衡
articles.abstract_en: Normal-form two-player games are categorized by players into K analogy classes so as to minimize the prediction error about the behaviour of the opponent. This results in Clustered Analogy-Based Expectation Equilibria in which strategies are analogy-based expectation equilibria given the analogy partitions and analogy partitions minimize the prediction errors given the strategies. We distinguish between environments with self-repelling analogy partitions in which some mixing over partitions is required and environments with self-attractive partitions in which several analogy partitions can arise, thereby suggesting new channels of belief heterogeneity and equilibrium multiplicity. Various economic applications are discussed.
articles.abstract_cn: 正常形式的二玩家博弈被玩家分为K个类比类，以最小化对手行为的预测误差。这导致基于集群类比的期望均衡，其中给定类比分区的策略是基于类比的期望均衡，并且类比分区最小化给定策略的预测误差。我们区分具有自排斥类比分区的环境（其中需要对分区进行一些混合）和具有自吸引分区的环境（其中可以出现多个类比分区），从而提出信念异质性和均衡多重性的新渠道。讨论了各种经济应用。

articles.title_en: Good Dispersion, Bad Dispersion
articles.title_cn: 分散性好、分散性差
articles.abstract_en: We document that most dispersion in marginal revenue products of inputs occurs across plants within firms rather than between firms. This is commonly thought to reflect misallocation: dispersion is “bad”. However, we show that eliminating frictions hampering internal capital markets in a multi-plant firm model may in fact increase productivity dispersion and raise output: dispersion can be “good”. This arises as firms optimally stagger investment activity across their plants over time to avoid raising costly external finance, instead relying on reallocating internal funds. The staggering in turn generates dispersion in marginal revenue products. We use U.S. Census data on multi-plant manufacturing firms to provide empirical evidence for the model mechanism and show a quantitatively important role for good dispersion. Since there is less scope for good dispersion in emerging economies, the difference in the degree of misallocation between emerging and developed economies looks more pronounced than previously thought.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了投入的边际收益产品的大部分分散发生在公司内部的工厂而不是公司之间。这通常被认为反映了配置不当：分散是“坏”的。然而，我们表明，消除多工厂企业模型中阻碍内部资本市场的摩擦实际上可能会增加生产力分散度并提高产出：分散度可能是“好的”。这种情况的出现是因为企业随着时间的推移最佳地错开其工厂的投资活动，以避免筹集昂贵的外部融资，而是依赖重新分配内部资金。这种惊人的结果反过来又导致了边际收益产品的分散。我们使用美国关于多工厂制造企业的人口普查数据为模型机制提供经验证据，并显示良好分散的定量重要作用。由于新兴经济体良好分散的空间较小，新兴经济体和发达经济体之间的错配程度差异看起来比之前想象的更为明显。

articles.title_en: Extreme Categories and Overreaction to News
articles.title_cn: 极端类别和对新闻的过度反应
articles.abstract_en: What characteristics of news generate over-or-underreaction? We study the asset-pricing consequences of diagnostic expectations, a model of belief formation based on the representativeness heuristic, in a setting where news events are drawn from categories with extreme distributions of fundamentals. Our model predicts greater overreaction to news belonging to categories with more extreme outliers, or tail events. We test our theory on a comprehensive database of corporate news that includes news from twenty-four different categories, including earnings announcements, product launches, mergers and acquisition, business expansions, and client-related news. We find theory-consistent heterogeneity in investor reaction to news, with more overreaction in the form of greater post-announcement return reversals and trading volume for news categories with more extreme distributions of fundamentals.
articles.abstract_cn: 新闻的哪些特征会导致反应过度或反应不足？我们研究诊断预期的资产定价后果，这是一种基于代表性启发式的信念形成模型，在新闻事件来自基本面极端分布类别的环境中。我们的模型预测，对于属于具有更极端异常值或尾部事件的类别的新闻，会有更大的过度反应。我们在一个综合的企业新闻数据库上测试我们的理论，该数据库包括二十-四不同类别的新闻，包括收益公告、产品发布、并购、业务扩张和客户相关新闻。我们发现，投资者对新闻的反应存在与理论一致的异质性，对于基本面分布更为极端的新闻类别，过度反应的形式包括更大的公告后回报逆转和交易量。

articles.title_en: Auctions with Frictions: Recruitment, Entry, and Limited Commitment
articles.title_cn: 存在摩擦的拍卖：招募、进入和有限承诺
articles.abstract_en: Auction models are convenient abstractions of informal price-formation processes that arise in markets for assets or services. These processes involve frictions like bidder recruitment costs for sellers, participation costs for bidders, and limitations on sellers’ commitment abilities. This paper develops an auction model that captures such frictions. We derive novel insights, notably that outcomes are often inefficient, that markets sometimes unravel, and that the observability of competition may have a large effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 拍卖模型是对资产或服务市场中出现的非正式价格形成过程的便捷抽象。这些过程涉及诸如卖方的投标人招募成本、投标人的参与成本以及卖方承诺能力的限制等摩擦。本文开发了一种捕捉此类摩擦的拍卖模型。我们得出新颖的见解，特别是结果往往效率低下，市场有时会崩溃，竞争的可观察性可能会产生很大的影响。

articles.title_en: Hiring as Exploration
articles.title_cn: 招聘作为探索
articles.abstract_en: This article views hiring as a contextual bandit problem: to find the best workers over time, firms must balance “exploitation” (selecting from groups with proven track records) with “exploration” (selecting from under-represented groups to learn about quality). Yet modern hiring algorithms, based on supervised learning approaches, are designed solely for exploitation. Instead, we build a resume screening algorithm that values exploration by evaluating candidates according to their statistical upside potential. Using data from professional services recruiting within a Fortune 500 firm, we show that this approach improves the quality (as measured by eventual hiring rates) of candidates selected for an interview, while also increasing demographic diversity, relative to the firm’s existing practices. The same is not true for traditional supervised learning-based algorithms, which improve hiring rates but select far fewer Black and Hispanic applicants. Together, our results highlight the importance of incorporating exploration in developing decision-making algorithms that are potentially both more efficient and equitable.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文将招聘视为一个上下文强盗问题：为了随着时间的推移找到最好的员工，公司必须平衡“剥削”（从有良好记录的群体中选择）和“探索”（从代表性不足的群体中选择以了解质量）。然而，基于监督学习方法的现代招聘算法只是为了剥削而设计的。相反，我们构建了一种简历筛选算法，通过根据统计上行潜力评估候选人来重视探索。使用《财富》500 公司内专业服务招聘的数据，我们表明，相对于公司现有的做法，这种方法提高了面试候选人的质量（通过最终招聘率衡量），同时也增加了人口多样性。对于传统的基于监督学习的算法来说情况并非如此，它提高了招聘率，但选择的黑人和西班牙裔申请人却少得多。总之，我们的结果凸显了将探索纳入开发可能更高效、更公平的决策算法的重要性。

articles.title_en: Community Enforcement with Endogenous Records
articles.title_cn: 使用内源记录进行社区执法
articles.abstract_en: I study repeated games with anonymous random matching where players can add or remove signals from their records. The ability to manipulate records introduces monotonicity constraints on players’ continuation values, under which sufficiently long-lived players will almost never cooperate. When players’ expected lifespans are intermediate, their ability to sustain cooperation depends on (i) whether their actions are complements or substitutes and (ii) whether manipulation takes the form of adding or removing signals.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了匿名随机匹配的重复游戏，玩家可以在记录中添加或删除信号。操纵记录的能力给玩家的持续价值带来了单调性约束，在这种情况下，足够长寿命的玩家几乎永远不会合作。当玩家的预期寿命处于中间时，他们维持合作的能力取决于（i）他们的行为是补充还是替代，以及（ii）操纵是否采取添加或删除信号的形式。

articles.title_en: Racial Discrimination and the Social Contract: Evidence from U.S. Army Enlistment During WWII
articles.title_cn: 种族歧视与社会契约：二战期间美国陆军入伍的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper documents that the Pearl Harbor attack triggered a sharp increase in volunteer enlistment rates of American men, the magnitude of the increase was smaller for Black men than for White men and the Black–White gap was larger in counties with higher levels of racial discrimination. The results suggest that political exclusion and discrimination can undermine support for the government during critical times such as war.
articles.abstract_cn: 该论文记录了珍珠港事件导致美国男性志愿者入伍率急剧上升，黑人男性的增长幅度小于白人，而且在种族歧视程度较高的县，黑人与白人的差距更大。结果表明，政治排斥和歧视可能会削弱在战争等关键时期对政府的支持。

articles.title_en: Complexity and Satisficing: Theory with Evidence from Chess
articles.title_cn: 复杂性和满意度：理论与国际象棋的证据
articles.abstract_en: We develop a satisficing model of choice in which the available alternatives differ in their inherent complexity. We assume—and experimentally validate—that complexity leads to errors in the perception of alternatives’ values. The model yields sharp predictions about the effect of complexity on choice probabilities, some of which qualitatively contrast with those of maximization-based choice models. We confirm the predictions of the satisficing model—and thus reject maximization—in a novel data set with information on hundreds of millions of real-world chess moves by highly experienced players. Looking beyond chess, our work offers a blueprint for incorporating complexity at the level of individual objects into models of choice and for detecting satisficing outside of the laboratory.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个令人满意的选择模型，其中可用的替代方案因其固有的复杂性而有所不同。我们假设并通过实验验证复杂性会导致对替代方案价值的认知错误。该模型对复杂性对选择概率的影响做出了敏锐的预测，其中一些预测与基于最大化的选择模型的预测形成了定性对比。我们在一个新颖的数据集中确认了满意模型的预测，从而拒绝最大化，其中包含经验丰富的棋手数以亿计的现实世界国际象棋棋步的信息。除了国际象棋之外，我们的工作还提供了一个蓝图，将单个对象级别的复杂性纳入选择的模型中，并在实验室外检测满意度。

articles.title_en: Behavioural Causal Inference
articles.title_cn: 行为因果推断
articles.abstract_en: When inferring causal effects from correlational data, a common practice by professional researchers but also lay people is to control for potential confounders. Inappropriate controls produce erroneous causal inferences. I model decision-makers (DMs) who use endogenous observational data to learn actions’ causal effect on payoff-relevant outcomes. Different DM types use different controls. Their resulting choices affect the very correlations they learn from, thus calling for an equilibrium analysis of the steady-state welfare cost of bad controls. I obtain tight upper bounds on this cost. Equilibrium forces drastically reduce it when types’ sets of controls contain one another.
articles.abstract_cn: 当从相关数据推断因果效应时，专业研究人员和非专业人士的常见做法是控制潜在的混杂因素。不适当的控制会产生错误的因果推论。我对决策者 (DM) 进行建模，他们使用内生观察数据来了解行为对回报相关结果的因果影响。不同的 DM 类型使用不同的控件。他们的最终选择会影响他们从中学到的相关性，因此需要对不良控制的稳态福利成本进行均衡分析。我得到了这个成本的严格上限。当类型的控制组包含一另一个时，平衡力会大大减少它。

articles.title_en: Cascades and Fluctuations in an Economy with an Endogenous Production Network
articles.title_cn: 具有内生生产网络的经济中的级联和波动
articles.abstract_en: This article studies the efficient allocation in an economy in which firms are connected through input–output linkages and must pay a fixed cost to produce. When economic conditions are poor, some firms might decide not to operate, thereby severing the links with their neighbours and changing the structure of the production network. Since producers benefit from having access to additional suppliers, nearby firms tend to operate, or not, together. As a result, the production network features clusters of operating firms, and the exit of a producer can create a cascade of firm shutdowns. While well-connected firms are better able to withstand shocks, they trigger larger cascades upon exit. The theory also predicts how the structure of the production network changes over the business cycle. As in the data, recessions are associated with more dispersed networks that feature fewer highly connected firms. In the calibrated economy, the endogenous reorganization of the network substantially dampens the impact of idiosyncratic shocks on aggregate fluctuations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了企业通过投入产出联系相连并且必须支付固定生产成本的经济中的有效配置。当经济状况不佳时，一些企业可能决定不经营，从而切断与邻居的联系并改变生产网络的结构。由于生产商受益于获得更多供应商，附近的公司往往会合作或不合作。因此，生产网络以经营企业集群为特征，生产商的退出可能会导致一系列企业倒闭。虽然人脉广泛的公司能够更好地抵御冲击，但它们在退出时会引发更大的连锁反应。该理论还预测了生产网络的结构如何随着经济周期而变化。正如数据所示，经济衰退与更加分散的网络有关，而网络的高度关联性较少。在校准经济中，网络的内生重组大大削弱了特殊冲击对总波动的影响。
